_comment: Curated, verified public job boards for mining companies. Every entry must resolve to a real, legal, public JSON feed. Platforms: greenhouse | lever | workable. NOTE: most large miners (BHP, Rio Tinto, Anglo American, Newmont, Glencore) run Workday / PageUp / SuccessFactors with no clean public JSON API — see ARCHITECTURE.md (Phase 2). Generic keyless APIs fill the gap.

optionalKeyed.name: Adzuna
optionalKeyed.note: Enabled when ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY env vars are set. Free tier.
